questions.question: Why did Kokichi Muta's parents believe he was dead?
questions.subject: Kokichi Muta/Synopsis

answer.item: Kokichi was taken into Jujutsu High's custody at a young age, with his parents thinking he died.

questions.question: What did Mechamaru do during the Night Parade of a Hundred Demons?
questions.subject: Kokichi Muta/Synopsis

answer.item: During the Night Parade of a Hundred Demons, Mechamaru exorcised curses in Kyoto along with his classmates, incinerating small fly-like curses that tried to ambush Kasumi.

questions.question: What did Kokichi Muta promise Pseudo-Geto's group in their binding vow?
questions.subject: Kokichi Muta/Synopsis

answer.item: He made a binding vow with them, agreeing to be their informant on the condition that they do not harm anyone from Kyoto Jujutsu High.

questions.question: What order did Principal Gakuganji give the Kyoto students before the Goodwill Event?
questions.subject: Kokichi Muta/Synopsis

answer.item: Mechamaru attended a pre-event meeting along with the other Kyoto students where they were ordered by Principal Yoshinobu Gakuganji to kill Yuji during the event.

questions.question: How did Panda defeat Mechamaru in the forest fight?
questions.subject: Kokichi Muta/Synopsis

answer.item: Confident in his victory, Mechamaru was caught off guard when Panda revealed he had misled him about the core's location, swiftly incapacitating him with a second Drumming Beat.

questions.question: How did Kokichi Muta fake his death during the fight with Mahito?
questions.subject: Kokichi Muta/Synopsis

answer.item: Having faked his death, Kokichi took the opportunity to pierce Mahito's body with the bullet, surprising the cursed spirit.

questions.question: What did Kokichi Muta tell Kasumi Miwa as his final puppet ran out of power?
questions.subject: Kokichi Muta/Synopsis

answer.item: He then confessed that he loved her and wanted to protect her no matter what happened to the world, even if he wasn't the person she wanted to rely on.
